name: date
description: Run date of the load that last wrote this row.

name: expand
description: Jira REST `expand` header from the issue envelope, listing sections that could be expanded on the request. Operational metadata, carried through unchanged.

name: id
description: Jira issue id. SCD1 merge key; unique across the table.

name: key
description: Jira issue key, e.g. ITV-1453.

name: self
description: REST API URL of the issue, e.g. .../rest/api/2/issue/316603. Stable handle back to the source system.

name: project
description: Project key derived from `key` by taking the part before the first '-'. The `project_key_matches` DQ rule checks it against fields.project.key.

name: project_name
description: Display name of the Jira project (fields.project.name), e.g. 'IT Vulnerability'.

name: issue_type_name
description: Issue type name (fields.issuetype.name) -- Epic, Story, Task, Sub-task, Bug.

name: resolution_name
description: Resolution name (fields.resolution.name). NULL while the issue is unresolved; Jira sets it only on closure.

name: created_date
description: Issue creation time (fields.created) as ISO-8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2023-04-01T03:20:19.677-0500. STRING because the output contract types only `date` and `id` as non-string.

name: resolved_date
description: Time the issue was resolved (fields.resolutiondate), same format as created_date. NULL while unresolved.

name: severity
description: Jira custom field customfield_11169 (.value). Instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: team
description: Jira custom field customfield_11067 (.value). Instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: global_release
description: Jira custom field customfield_11089 (.value) -- the release train the issue is targeted at. 'Not planned' throughout the reference export.

name: story_points
description: Jira Software story point estimate (customfield_10026). Numeric in Jira, typed STRING here per the output contract.

name: priority
description: Priority name (fields.priority.name) -- Highest, High, Medium, Low, Lowest.

name: bug_type
description: Jira custom field customfield_11191 (.value). Instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: summary
description: Issue summary -- the one-line title (fields.summary).

name: testing_scope
description: Jira custom field customfield_11137, read as a scalar rather than an option object. Instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: engineering_area
description: Jira custom field customfield_11130 (.value). Instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: automation_test_name
description: Jira custom field customfield_11132, read as a scalar. Instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: status
description: Current workflow status name (fields.status.name) -- e.g. Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Done. Workflows are configurable per project, so the value set is not fixed across projects.

name: reporter
description: Display name of the reporter (fields.reporter.displayName) -- the person the issue is raised on behalf of. See `channel` for the distinction from creator.

name: assignee_name
description: Display name of the current assignee (fields.assignee.displayName). NULL when unassigned.

name: total_acv
description: Jira custom field customfield_10948, read as a scalar. Name suggests annual contract value; instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: program
description: Jira custom field customfield_11087 (.value). Instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: execution_comments
description: Jira custom field customfield_11104, read as a scalar. Instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: display_in_big_picture
description: Jira custom field customfield_11079 (.value) -- flags the issue for roadmap/portfolio views. 'Yes' is the only value in the reference export.

name: updated
description: Jira 'updated' timestamp as a string. Drives the MERGE's staleness predicate.

name: engineering_feedback
description: Jira custom field customfield_11099 (.value). Instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: proposed_text_for_limitation_or_resolved_issue
description: Jira custom field customfield_11118, read as a scalar -- release-note text for a limitation or resolved issue. Instance-specific custom field; no non-null values in the reference export, so its value domain is unverified here.

name: customer_request_type
description: Jira Service Management request type (customfield_10002.requestType.name). NULL for issues outside a service project. When Jira cannot resolve the field it returns an error object instead, which the `request_type_no_error_stub` DQ rule counts.

name: project_type
description: Jira project type key (fields.project.projectTypeKey) -- software, service_desk or business.

name: channel
description: Display name of the issue's creator (fields.creator.displayName). Named 'channel' by the output contract. Jira distinguishes creator (the account that filed the issue) from reporter (who it is filed on behalf of); they diverge when issues arrive via an integration or customer portal.

name: etl_ts
description: UTC time this row was last inserted or updated by the MERGE. Unlike `date` (the export's arrival date, which a backfill moves backwards), this only ever moves forward.
